name: Fake Speaker Term MES
description: Synthetic fixture representing a strategy extracted from a YouTube video where the speaker used a proprietary term ('fake_speaker_term') not yet registered in the ARCHETYPE_REGISTRY. This routes to the uncatalogued: prefix so the Pine compiler emits an alert-only scaffold using the speaker's verbatim term as the display name. Pass 2 Track B handles the uncatalogued: prefix handler in both pine_compiler.py and exportability.py.

entry_params.verbatim_description: When price forms a 'fake speaker term' pattern at a key level with volume confirmation, enter on the close of the confirmation candle.

entry_condition: Speaker-specific concept: price forms the 'fake speaker term' pattern at a prior swing high/low with above-average volume, confirmed by a strong close in the trade direction.
